variants.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Single high-fidelity Chinese health education video still, independent full-bleed 16:9 landscape frame, like one 1920×1080 broadcast frame. Output one complete design image.
Input image: existing same-video screenshot is reference for the presenter appearance, Chinese type scale, blue medical palette, and five independently placed blocks. Recompose the whole frame using the layout below.
Use a modern, calm, flat medical editorial style. Pale blue-white canvas, white content surface, navy text, one medium-blue accent and a small restrained coral indicator for cramp location. Use the same friendly middle-aged East Asian male pharmacist from the reference, glasses, white coat and light-blue shirt, only once. Clean simplified anatomical side-view of the calf localized with a small coral mark, plus three plain labels in the content graphic. At small playback size the headline, labels, and subtitles should be easy to read. Consistent moderate padding and generous readable typography for the footer.
Render each of these exact visible text strings once, no extra words, no English, no metadata, no invented numbering. Global topic: “腿抽筋，先别急着补钙”. Four chapter labels in this order with the first active: “找原因” “辨差异” “怎么做” “何时就医”. Presenter identification: “李明远” “主任药师” “北京协和医院”. Disclaimer: “科普内容仅供参考，具体诊疗与用药请遵医嘱”. Content graphic headline: “腿抽筋有多种可能原因”. Three content graphic labels: “肌肉用力过多” “脱水” “电解质异常”. Subtitle: “先别急着补钙，抽筋不一定只怪缺钙，”.
Use accurate simplified Chinese glyphs and rendering, moderate bold weight for content headline, one-line clear subtitle darker than the background or white on a flat navy band. Keep a comfortable bottom safe margin. Show global topic, chapters, presenter/credentials/disclaimer, the unified content infographic, and subtitle as independently placed design blocks. No annotation rectangles, browser chrome, other people, logos, watermark, gradient, glow, stock UI filler, extra text, or fake icons.

Layout 1, fixed presenter column on the left. Top horizontal header with topic at left and compact chapter rail at right. Body with a 23% pale-blue presenter column of smaller circular photo, simple credential stack, and disclaimer under it; a clean 77% large white rectangular content card on the right. Inside the card, headline across the top, big calf drawing left of the three generously spaced stacked labels. Full-width independent centered subtitle at bottom. Use a fine blue portrait border, with the content card dominating.

variants.editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: this generated single Chinese 16:9 video design frame. Adjust one block only: turn the tall right-hand pharmacist card into a clearly smaller picture-in-picture block, anchored in the lower-right corner inside the main illustration area. Move its top edge down to roughly 60% of the canvas height. Use a compact horizontal presenter window (16:9 photo) around 15%–17% of the frame width, with the same face, and two compact lines of exact credentials “李明远” “主任药师” “北京协和医院” aligned in a short nameplate. Set the right edge flush with the inside of the infographic card. The top right should read as whitespace within the large white main infographic rather than a standing sidebar. Keep the nearby disclaimer below the presenter block, exactly “科普内容仅供参考，具体诊疗与用药请遵医嘱”. Maintain strong contrast and leave the blue full-width subtitle band unchanged.
Preserve the existing wording verbatim, especially “腿抽筋，先别急着补钙”, the four chapter labels, “腿抽筋有多种可能原因”, the three infographic labels and the exact subtitle “先别急着补钙，抽筋不一定只怪缺钙，”. Keep the leg illustration, chapter rail, typography, canvas ratio, palette and the flat visual style. Remove the original tall portrait so only the new inset presenter appears. One finished frame without annotations, other text, or watermarks.
